definitions.explanation: The player in soccer, hockey, or similar sports who defends the goal and is the only player allowed to use their hands within the penalty area.

examples.japanese: ゴールキーパーが{見事|みごと}なセーブを{見|み}せた。
examples.english: The goalkeeper made a brilliant save.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}からゴールキーパーをしている。
examples.english: He has been playing goalkeeper since childhood.

examples.japanese: ゴールキーパーが{飛|と}び{出|だ}して{ボール|ぼーる}をキャッチした。
examples.english: The goalkeeper came out and caught the ball.

notes:
ABBREVIATION:
・GK (written abbreviation)
・キーパー (spoken abbreviation)

SOCCER POSITIONS:
・ゴールキーパー (goalkeeper)
・ディフェンダー (defender)
・ミッドフィルダー (midfielder)
・フォワード (forward)

RELATED TERMS:
・セーブ (save)
・PK{戦|せん} (penalty shootout)
・{無失点|むしってん} (clean sheet)
